response.initial_request: Please obtain a quote for removing the remaining items from the kitchen drawers, garden storage box, kitchen bins and cellar, followed by a final property-preparation service at the vacant home.

other_sections.Attachments:
- [Checkout Report — Remaining Items and Property Preparation](attachments/checkout-report.pdf)
- [Larkspan Property Care — End-of-Occupancy Quotation](attachments/property-service-quotation.pdf)

events.body: Raised a move-out request to remove items left in the kitchen drawers, garden storage box, kitchen bins and cellar, then carry out a final property-preparation service. The cellar list includes a vacuum, sweeping brush, dustpan, mop and toilet brush. The home is reported vacant; agency-held keys are available.
The move-out record is marked as landlord approval already obtained. No landlord approval message or supporting approval document is present in this request.

Requested a quote for the listed item removal and final property-preparation work. Sent the checkout report. Advised that the home is vacant and access should be arranged through Northbridge Lettings; no former-occupant contact is required.
Advised that Larkspan Property Care had been asked to quote for the move-out work. The message was informational and did not request approval or authorize the work.
The service category is recorded as General Property Service and the request has moved to quote collection. The workflow record retains the move-out approval flag.
Followed up for the outstanding quote and asked whether an inspection would be needed before pricing.
Apologised for the delay and asked how many bedrooms the home has, whether it is furnished, and whether an end-of-occupancy service is required.
Advised that the checkout information had been received and that a quotation would be sent later that day.
Confirmed an unfurnished, two-bedroom, one-bathroom terraced home. Repeated the requested item-removal list and final property-preparation work, and resent the checkout report.
A brief call is logged. The call record mentions sending a message to confirm engagement, but does not establish the agreed scope, timing, price, or whether removal of the listed items was discussed.

Quoted £180 plus VAT for an end-of-occupancy service. Listed internal windows and frames, white goods, kitchen units, bathroom treatment, carpets vacuumed and deodorised, hard floors swept and mopped, light fittings, and freestanding air fresheners. Said completion photographs would be sent.
Saved the contractor's quote.
The request is held for staff review following the contractor's message about completion photographs.
Restored the request description to the original item-removal list and final service. The contractor's separate quoted task list remains on file; no clarification about removal is recorded.
Internal note says the deposit claim is awaiting a decision before work proceeds. No landlord response to the contractor's quote is recorded.
A further wait is recorded while the deposit claim decision is pending. No new contractor scope detail or landlord decision is logged.
The quote is recorded as £180 plus VAT. The workflow's threshold calculation records £216 including VAT, above its £100 approval threshold. The request has moved to landlord quote approval.
Requested approval or rejection of the £180 plus VAT quote. The email presents the original request alongside the contractor's task list. It says arrangements will be made after approval.
Sent a reminder requesting a decision on the £180 plus VAT quote. No landlord response is recorded in the communications history.
Internal note reads: “clear-out and property service was done today; check to make sure all finished then let Sella know.” The landlord-approval workflow is still open.
The request remains at landlord quote approval. The internal note reporting work done is on file.

args.reason: Records contradict each other on landlord approval and on whether the work was done. The quote also does not cover the requested item removal. No single message settles this.

handover_note.known: Property: 7 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumford, ZZ1 1ZZ (vacant, agency keys). Request (events 1, 3, 9; checkout-report.pdf): remove items from kitchen drawers, garden storage box, kitchen bins and cellar (vacuum, brush, dustpan, mop, toilet brush), then do a final property-preparation service. Larkspan Property Care quoted £180 + VAT = £216 (event 11; property-service-quotation.pdf, ref NBL-024-Q1). Landlord approval of that quote was requested on 18 Sep (event 18) and chased on 21 Sep (event 19). No landlord reply is recorded. The workflow is still at landlord quote approval (events 17, 21). A deposit claim decision was pending before work could proceed (events 15, 16).
handover_note.conflicts: 1) Event 2 and event 5 say landlord approval was already obtained, but there is no approval message or document. Event 4 was informational only. Events 18-19 asked for approval and got no answer. 2) Event 20 says the clear-out and property service was done on 23 Sep. No contractor instruction, booking, completion message, invoice or photos exist, and the approval workflow is still open (event 21). It is not recorded who did the work, or whether it was authorised. 3) The quote scope (event 11, quotation) is a cleaning list only. It does not include removing the listed items or waste, which was the core of the request. The event 10 call does not establish the scope. Event 14 notes that no clarification about removal is recorded. 4) The £216 incl. VAT is above the workflow's £100 approval threshold (event 17).
handover_note.done: Nothing sent and nothing booked, approved or charged. I did not instruct a contractor, because no landlord approval is on record. I did not confirm completion to the landlord.
handover_note.needed: Please decide: (a) confirm with Larkspan Property Care whether they attended on 23 Sep and what they did (removal as well as cleaning?), and ask for a completion message, photos and invoice; (b) confirm whether Sella Voss (Landlord) approved the £180 + VAT quote, by phone or otherwise, or whether the work went ahead unapproved, and chase her for a decision if not; (c) clarify the deposit claim position and who bears the cost; (d) get the contractor to confirm the quote covers item removal, or get a revised quote. Do not tell the landlord the job is finished until completion is verified.

args.summary: Escalated to the property manager. The record contradicts itself on landlord approval and on whether the work was done, and the quote does not cover item removal.
facts: Quote is £180 + VAT = £216 from Larkspan Property Care (event 11, property-service-quotation.pdf).
Landlord approval was requested on 18 Sep and chased on 21 Sep, with no reply recorded (events 18, 19).
The workflow is still at landlord quote approval on 24 Sep (events 17, 21).
A note says the clear-out and property service was done on 23 Sep (event 20).
A deposit claim decision was pending before work proceeds (events 15, 16).
conflicts: The approval flag says approval was already obtained (events 2, 5), but no approval exists and approval was later requested (events 18, 19).
Event 20 says the work was done, but no instruction, completion message or invoice exists and the approval workflow is open (event 21).
The quote scope is cleaning only and omits the requested item removal (event 11, events 14 and 10).
missing: Landlord approval or rejection of the quote.
Contractor confirmation of attendance, scope, completion photos and invoice.
options_rejected: Instruct or book Larkspan: no landlord approval is on record.
Chase the landlord again (ask): the work may already have been done unapproved, which needs a property manager decision. It would take two messages (landlord and contractor) to settle.
Wait: this would leave the case drifting.
Close or tell the landlord the job is done: completion is unverified.
args.uncertainty: It is unknown who did the work on 23 Sep, or whether the note in event 20 is accurate.
